about: Companion of ghidra_name_fixes.json (written by the EU/USA map audit, albw-decomp-ai tools/eu_map_audit.py, decomp commit 7b09bf84). The Ghidra projects (build/ghidra_all, ghidra_analyzed..5) named every EU function func_<USA> by the OLD map (first USA in sorted order claims an EU address; checked against all six dumps' definition lines). ghidra_name_fixes.json maps each wrong Ghidra-project name to the USA name the corrected map gives that EU function. Apply it to raw Ghidra text only, BEFORE eu_fun_to_usa(): with the corrected map, FUN_<EU> of fun_collision_keys' EU functions resolve to the key names, which are then correct and must not be renamed (0 such FUN_ references in ghidra_analyzed5 today). Never apply it to matched sources (src/work*): they use real USA names (matched_sources_using_key_names). Substitution must be simultaneous (one regex pass): values_that_are_keys entries chain.
bogus_start_names_no_action: 8 Ghidra sources call func_00391558/func_00256034/func_002567B0, Ghidra names of non-start EU addresses 00391538/00256008/00256784; the EU code calls the true starts, whose USA names these are: correct as printed.

extra_function_aliases.about: NOT part of ghidra_name_fixes.json. 128 'extra' functions (build/systemic3/extra_functions.json, ghidra_extra5; albw_dump_extra.py gave them a guessed USA name) sit at EU starts the corrected map now gives to table functions: func_<fake> -> func_<USA>. Callers using the fake names call the right EU code today (the extra source holds its body), so these names are consistent and need no change; once build/ghidra_mapfix is in, the extra definitions duplicate the table functions' bodies. Optional cleanup: drop these entries from extra_functions.json and rename; build_decomp's eu2usa.update(extra) must then not override map entries (tools/ghidra_mapfix.py uses setdefault).
